events.label: George Steinbrenner suspension for hiring gambler

slots.name: suspension length
slots.sentence: He survived Steinbrenner’s attempts to bring ruin him, but in the end, it was Steinbrenner who went down, receiving a lifetime suspension that was reduced to 2 ½ years for hiring a gambler in a failed attempt to destroy Winfield’s reputation.
